exclusion_reason: Single-thread CPU-deterministic record and replay hash-match locally and are deterministic on any host by construction, but the literal second-machine leg is not certified in this suite and multi-threaded schedule determinism (BPTK-051 guest SMP) is outside the single-thread record, so the full cross-machine SMP replay stays red.
promotion_trigger: Promote to passing when two local replays and a replay on a second machine produce the identical state hash at every checkpoint, including a multi-threaded guest schedule.
expected_failing_assertion: The second-machine replay is not executed in this suite and the guest SMP schedule (BPTK-051) is not yet deterministic, so the cross-machine multi-threaded state hash cannot be compared.
active_gate_evidence: test/replay.test.mjs records a run through the recompiler with every declared nondeterminism source pinned (virtual-monotonic clock, no host RNG, no host input, single-thread schedule) and asserts two replays hash-match at every instruction-count checkpoint, that the recompiler and interpreter agree at every checkpoint (the cross-machine foundation), that no pinned source is host-derived (is_host_source_free), that a tampered checkpoint hash is detected as divergence, and that the second-machine and SMP-schedule legs are declared red.
procedure: Record the fixture run with every declared nondeterminism source pinned.
Replay twice locally and once on a second machine.
Compare the guest state hash at every declared checkpoint.
pass_criterion: All replay hash-match at every checkpoint.
No pinned source is read from the host environment.
